record.body:
## Correction

Do not add a new numbered step to skills/init/SKILL.md and do not renumber its steps. skills/plan-phase/SKILL.md ("init step 6", "init step 7") and skills/settle-phase/SKILL.md ("init step 7 shape") cite init step numbers: step 6 creates the effort and step 7 creates the phases. Put the placement text inside step 6, after the effort and brief creation: when the routing line from engage names an area (not none), run orchestra place <effort-slug> <area>. Revert the renumbering and the changed in-text reference. Keep the skills/engage/SKILL.md change. Re-run the same tests and python3 scripts/build_skills.py --check.
record.subject: fix-engage-place-hook
